name: Superhuman Mail
description: Superhuman Mail is a productivity-focused email client for Gmail and Outlook that uses keyboard shortcuts, automatic triage, and AI features to help users process their inbox significantly faster.
best_for: Positioned as an AI-native email client for professionals who process high volumes of email and want to fly through their inbox faster with keyboard-driven workflows.
features: Split Inbox that automatically triages email by sender type (team, VIPs, tools like Google Docs and Asana)
AI drafting and sending of emails on the user's behalf
Read statuses showing when recipients open an email and on what device
Snippets for automating common phrases and full email templates
Follow-up reminders with customizable timing windows
Collision detection to prevent duplicate team responses
Keyboard shortcuts and Instant Reply for rapid navigation and response
Integrated calendar viewing and event creation from within email

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $40/month or $396/year; adds Auto Drafts, Ask AI, custom auto labels, CRM integrations, and Recent Opens.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing; advanced security, SSO, dedicated support, and enterprise controls.

cons: Superhuman Mail has no permanent free tier; Starter is $30 per member monthly ($300/year) and Business is $40 per member monthly ($396/year).
Advanced AI workflows such as Auto Drafts and Ask AI are Business-tier features, while SSO and advanced security and controls require Enterprise.

alternatives.name: Front
alternatives.description: A shared inbox and customer communication platform for teams managing high volumes of email.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that need a shared inbox with collaboration on customer-facing email
